subject.title: Fix Codex fork identity and cache invalidation

question: Should maintainers land this original, actively maintained branch, select https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2120 as the canonical copy, or first combine either one with the ancestry behavior in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2113?
rationale: Both this PR and the parallel PR are proof-positive landing candidates, while the adjacent ancestry PR changes related session ownership behavior; automation cannot safely choose the canonical branch or permanent composition policy.

options.title: Land this original branch
options.body: Review this PR against the two related branches, preserve its latest cache-gate optimization, then close the redundant implementation while tracking broader accounting separately.

options.title: Land the parallel branch
options.body: Choose https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2120 if its independent proof and presentation are preferred, then close this PR with explicit attribution preserved.

options.title: Reconcile ancestry first
options.body: Pause both identity/cache candidates until maintainers decide which ownership and historical parent-resolution pieces from https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2113 belong in one combined patch.

recommendation.title: Land this original branch
recommendation.body: Review this PR against the two related branches, preserve its latest cache-gate optimization, then close the redundant implementation while tracking broader accounting separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available decision owner for selecting between competing proof-positive landing branches and defining their interaction with adjacent work.
